limitations: Designed for gentle nudges on a firm, level desk; large pushes can overturn it.
Settling depends on desk level, friction and print quality.
Physical printing, durability and human use have not been tested.
summary: A palm-sized solid desk rocker. A gentle finger nudge sets its curved underside rolling, while gravity draws it back toward its level resting position.
title: Quiet Arc
what_arrives: One solid Quiet Arc desk rocker.
Two-sided owner card with setup, use and care instructions.
